summary.intent: Push the conflict-resolved merge to PR #8, sync local main, and then split the app's UX between a senior buyer and a procurement person with two sign-ins (same password), different inbox views, and a History view.
summary.outcome: PR #8 was pushed, found mergeable, and later merged; main was pulled (360 tests pass) and the role split was built (person choice at sign-in, Maren's filtered inbox and menu, new History page, who-decided on activity items), with lint, tests and build passing and a commit made. The 335 portal data files still sit on main.

repo: Entire checks (`entire status`, `entire brain status`) are required before pushing; Entire uploads its pending checkpoint along with the push.
The app reads files from its own store and mirrors them into `data/portal/`; live app state lives in `data/state`.
Challenge rules say not to commit portal data, yet PR #8 merged 335 files under `data/portal/` into main; local copies match the portal's checksums.
Live (:8000) and demo (:8001) servers run old code until restarted; the demo's state is kept across restarts.
Sign-in names come from data (approver resolution): Felix Brunner (senior buyer) and Dr. Maren Vogt (procurement).
Routines/automations belong to the senior buyer, so Maren's menu omits Routines (she gets Launch, Inbox, History, Suppliers); Felix keeps everything plus History.
Maren's 'important' inbox filter uses fields already on Card: red level, her sign-off, or a price.
Activity items did not record who decided, so a who-decided field was added to support History.
Web checks: typecheck, lint (ruff), 360 Python tests and a web build all pass after the change.

code.finding: New History page, modeled on Launch's layout classes and date formatters, showing activity with who decided.

workflow: Verify merge state and content after pulling (compare local files to portal checksums read-only) rather than assuming changes.
Ask before pushing to a teammate's remote branch; run required repo checks first.
Check that line length/lint issues are fixed before committing, then run tests and build.

friction: Merge conflict in test_shortfall.py where both branches added tests at the same spot required keeping both sets.
PR #8 was merged by someone else while the portal data removal was still pending, so the data files landed on main.
Line-length lint failure needed a fix pass before lint/test/build went green.
open_items: Remove the 335 portal files from main with `git rm -r --cached data/portal`, a commit and a push (they remain in history).
Restart the live (:8000) and demo (:8001) servers so they pick up Farhan's reading baseline and the new role split.
The role-split commit was made but not confirmed pushed.
Procurement's History could be made more prominent than for the senior buyer; the user left this open ('probably everyone but maybe more prominent').
